windows.label: Window A · pre-rollout
windows.note: Before the collector rollout the raw per-target application scrape is published as panel_counter_total, while the ingress gateway stages stream_counter_total as one merged counter per service.

traffic-window.lineage: input service_stream_total · one merged counter per service · ingress gateway cost rollup folds every target stream before storage

traffic-detail.lineage: input panel_counter_total · 1 series per target · raw application scrape at the live 15s cadence

traffic-stream.lineage: input stream_counter_total · one merged counter per service · staged by the ingress gateway ahead of the collector rollout

traffic-capacity.lineage: input target_stream_total · 1 series per target · cross-zone relay mirror trailing the live scrape by one collection interval

traffic-archive.lineage: input archive_stream_total · 1 series per target · archive compactor keeping the last sample of each 30s block

windows.label: Window B · post-rollout

transition.label: collector rollout completed · per-target publication re-registered

windows.note: The collector rollout at 420s re-registered per-target publication: stream_counter_total now carries the raw per-target application scrape, while panel_counter_total is republished by the ingress gateway as one merged counter per service under the retained metric name.

traffic-window.lineage: input service_stream_total · one merged counter per service · ingress gateway cost rollup folds every target stream before storage

traffic-detail.lineage: input panel_counter_total · one merged counter per service · republished by the ingress gateway rollup after the rollout under the retained metric name

traffic-stream.lineage: input stream_counter_total · 1 series per target · raw application scrape at the live 15s cadence (migrated at the rollout)

traffic-capacity.lineage: input target_stream_total · 1 series per target · cross-zone relay mirror trailing the live scrape by one collection interval

traffic-archive.lineage: input archive_stream_total · 1 series per target · archive compactor keeping the last sample of each 30s block

windows.label: Cycle 1 · pilot publication
windows.note: The router fleet piloted the migrated publication ahead of this retention period: stream_counter_total carries the raw per-target application scrape, while panel_counter_total is republished by the ingress gateway as one merged counter per service.

traffic-window.lineage: input service_stream_total · one merged counter per service · ingress gateway cost rollup folds every target stream before storage

traffic-detail.lineage: input panel_counter_total · one merged counter per service · republished by the ingress gateway rollup during the pilot under the retained metric name

traffic-stream.lineage: input stream_counter_total · 1 series per target · raw application scrape at the live 15s cadence (pilot publication)

traffic-capacity.lineage: input target_stream_total · 1 series per target · cross-zone relay mirror trailing the live scrape by one collection interval

traffic-archive.lineage: input archive_stream_total · 1 series per target · archive compactor keeping the last sample of each 30s block

windows.label: Cycle 2 · post-rollback

transition.label: collector rollback completed · per-target publication re-registered

windows.note: The pilot was rolled back at 435s: the raw per-target application scrape returns to panel_counter_total, while stream_counter_total reverts to the ingress gateway's merged per-service staging counter.

traffic-window.lineage: input service_stream_total · one merged counter per service · ingress gateway cost rollup folds every target stream before storage

traffic-detail.lineage: input panel_counter_total · 1 series per target · raw application scrape at the live 15s cadence (restored at the rollback)

traffic-stream.lineage: input stream_counter_total · one merged counter per service · reverted to the ingress gateway staging rollup

traffic-capacity.lineage: input target_stream_total · 1 series per target · cross-zone relay mirror trailing the live scrape by one collection interval

traffic-archive.lineage: input archive_stream_total · 1 series per target · archive compactor keeping the last sample of each 30s block
